title: When EM Struggles
failure_modes: Local optima — mitigate with k-means++ and multiple restarts.
Slow crawl near convergence — judge on log-likelihood change.
Wrong number of components — choose k with BIC/AIC.

decision_framework.always: restarts + k-means++ + covariance regularization + model selection

figures.nb06_good_vs_bad: A good solution vs a bad local optimum on the same data.
figures.nb06_init_strategies: k-means++ reaches the best basin far more often than random.
figures.nb06_model_selection: BIC/AIC recover the true component count.
